title: Rescaling and reflection of the convolution integral for an even kernel
statement: Let n in N, let rho, h : R^n -> R with rho(-z) = rho(z) for all z, x0 in R^n and t > 0. Then int_{R^n} t^{-n} rho(t^{-1} y) h(x0 - y) dy = int_{R^n} rho(z) h(x0 + t z) dz, with respect to Lebesgue measure. No integrability hypothesis is needed, since every identity used holds for the Bochner integral of an arbitrary function.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (ρ h : Rn n → ℝ) (x₀ : Rn n) (t : ℝ), 0 < t → (∀ z : Rn n, ρ (-z) = ρ z) → ∫ y, t⁻¹ ^ n * ρ (t⁻¹ • y) * h (x₀ - y) = ∫ z, ρ z * h (x₀ + t • z)
